agreement_definition: agreement_count is the number of models voting for the modal crop; ties in the modal crop name are broken alphabetically only for deterministic reporting.
experiment: Inter-model disagreement using original six classifier definitions
interpretation: This is inter-model disagreement among six established classifiers, not a formal posterior uncertainty estimate.
limitations: The six models are not independent samples from a probabilistic model family.
Agreement can be high even when all models share dataset-specific biases.
Results apply only to the fixed benchmark split and model definitions.
